blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — An investigation by the Philippine Statistics Authority’s (PSA) fraud management division in relation to the case of businessman Joseph Sy found evidence indicating that fake documents may have been procured during his birth registration. Sy, former chairman of Global Ferronickel Holdings Inc, was arrested at the Ninoy Aquino International Airport last year over suspicions that he had misrepresented his Filipino citizenship. Immigration records supposedly showed that his fingerprints matched those of a Chinese national named Chen Zhong Zhen. Presiding over the hearing of the Senate subcommittee on justice on Thursday, Sen. Risa Hontiveros asked the PSA about its final […]...
